_meta.purpose: Rule code -> learner-facing badge content. These fire on PRESENCE, not on error: a segment shows a badge for every rule that structurally occurs in it, whether or not the learner got it right. That is the difference from tajweed_error_registry_v3.json, whose entries all describe a MISTAKE.
_meta.source: «Тажвид (Қуръон ўқиш қоидалари)» — Абдулҳаким қори Комилжон ўғли, «Имом Бухорий халқаро маркази», Самарқанд, 2018. Approved by Uzbekistan's Committee on Religious Affairs, decision 1164, 27 Feb 2018.
_meta.authored_by: Rahmatulloh, transcribed from the printed text. NOT generated. Every uz.name / uz.rule / uz.example string is copied from the brief verbatim; nothing here was written by a model and nothing may be.

status_values.draft: not shown to a learner. Same gate as the error registry - see coverage.is_reviewed().
status_values.reviewed: a qualified qori has signed the strings off.

_meta.RU_IS_DELIBERATELY_ABSENT: No Russian was authored for these entries, so none is present. Writing it here would mean a model authoring tajweed instruction, which is the one thing this file may not contain. The client falls back to the Uzbek string for a Russian UI and the badge is still gated by status, so nothing unreviewed reaches anyone either way. Russian needs the same transcription pass the Uzbek got.
_meta.detection: engine/rule_presence.py. Derived from the reference phonetic script alone - never from a recording.

RULE_MADD_LOZIM.trigger: madd letter + shaddah in the same word, OR a muqatta'at letter-name

uz.name: Mad lozim
uz.rule: Mad harfidan keyin tashdidli harf yoki muqattaʿat harf nomi kelsa, 6 harakat cho'ziladi — bu eng uzun mad turi.
uz.example: ٱلضَّآلِّينَ, يَتَمَآسَّا, va الٓمٓ kabi sura boshidagi yakka harflar.

RULE_MADD_MUTTASIL.trigger: madd letter + hamza in the SAME word

uz.name: Mad vojib (muttasil)
uz.rule: Mad harfidan keyin hamza bir so'z ichida kelsa, 4-5 harakat cho'ziladi.

RULE_MADD_MUNFASIL.trigger: madd letter at word end + hamza starting the NEXT word
RULE_MADD_MUNFASIL.scoring_note: 2 is the baseline for scoring. 4 and 5 are reciter choices and are NOT penalised.

uz.name: Mad joiz (munfasil)
uz.rule: Mad harfi bir so'z oxirida, hamza esa keyingi so'z boshida kelsa, 2, 4 yoki 5 harakat cho'zish mumkin — qori ixtiyoriga bog'liq.

RULE_MADD_TABIIY.trigger: madd letter with no following hamza or sukun

uz.name: Mad tabiiy
uz.rule: Oddiy holatda mad harfi 2 harakat cho'ziladi — bu eng asosiy va eng ko'p uchraydigan mad turi.

RULE_IKHFO_GHUNNA.trigger: sukunli nun/tanvin + one of the 15 ikhfo letters, OR tashdidli nun/mim

uz.name: Ixfo va g'unna
uz.rule: Sukunli «nuvn» yoki tanvin 15 ta ixfo harfidan biriga yo'liqsa, yashirin va burun tovushi (g'unna) bilan, 2 harakat o'qiladi.

RULE_IDGHOM.trigger: any of the idgham subtypes (mislayn, mutajanisayn, mutaqaribayn, shamsiyya)

uz.name: Idg'om
uz.rule: Bir harf ikkinchi harf ichiga kiritilib, alohida talaffuz qilinmaydi.

uz.name: Tafxim
uz.rule: Iste'lo harflari (خ ص ض ط ظ غ ق) doim yo'g'on o'qiladi.

uz.name: Qalqala
uz.rule: Sukunli ق ط ب ج د harflarida yengil sakrash tovushi eshitiladi.
